consequence.statement: Custom logging configuration written for Reload4j/Log4j1 might need to be updated to Log4j2 during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.
consequence.remediation: Review and update custom logging configuration for Log4j2 when upgrading to Kafka 4.0.

assertion.statement: Kafka 4.0 and newer uses Log4j2 instead of Reload4j/Log4j1, so custom logging configuration may need updating when upgrading to Kafka 4.0.
